physicalNotes: Radius 0.09055239 Jupiter radii from Hirano et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..131H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..131H/abstract): 6,473.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Hirano et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..131H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..131H/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.02359764 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
